user.title: Connect to WTH UMR2 Regulator
user.description: Enter the IP address of your WTH UMR2 regulator.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of your WTH UMR2 device on your local network

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Please check the IP address and ensure the device is reachable on your network.
error.timeout: Connection to the device timed out. Please check the IP address and ensure the device is powered on and connected to your network.
error.invalid_response: The device returned an invalid response. Please ensure this is a WTH UMR2 regulator.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
